findings.reason: The source proves the geometric chord/tangent construction and the reflection sign but contains no diagram. A concrete real model materially clarifies the third intersection, reflection and tangent multiplicity; its scope is explicitly illustrative rather than a real picture of every complex cubic.
findings.action: Added a three-panel TikZ illustration and explanatory caption to the existing Remarks section.

correction: Added a real cubic secant/reflection, nonvertical tangent/reflection, and vertical inverse-pair illustration. Caption records the half-period and line-at-infinity multiplicities without falsely plotting infinity as an affine point.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Illustrative real projective cubic Y^2 Z=4X^3-4XZ^2; affine equation y^2=4x^3-4x, O=[0:1:0].
diagram_math_checks.check: g2=4, g3=0 gives discriminant 64. Affine roots -1,0,1 are distinct. Plot domains [-1,0] and [1,1.9] are exactly real branches in this displayed window; negative y branches are reflected positive branches. Axis compression changes no intersections.

Substitution gives 4x(x^2-x-1)=0, with three distinct roots. Source coordinates approximate these points to six decimals. Step 3.2 gives P⊕Q⊕R=O and step 1.1 identifies negation with (x,y)↦(x,-y); the downward dashed arrow terminates at -R, so P⊕Q=-R. Numeric residuals at exact coordinates were at most 2.3e-16.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Tangent at A=(-1/2,sqrt(6)/2), slope m=-1/sqrt(6), intercept b=5/(2sqrt(6)); residual B=(25/24,35/(24sqrt(6))).
diagram_math_checks.check: A and B satisfy the cubic and y=mx+b. The derivative condition 2m y_A=12x_A^2-4=-1 holds. Substitution factors the line intersection polynomial as -4(x+1/2)^2(x-25/24), giving divisor 2A+B, not 3A. The label A (2) records double contact; the dashed arrow reflects B to -B, yielding A⊕A=-B. Floating residual checks were below 5.1e-16.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Vertical line x=3/2 through V=(3/2,sqrt(15/2)) and -V, and projective point O.
diagram_math_checks.check: 4(3/2)^3-4(3/2)=15/2 is nonzero, so the two finite intersections are distinct simple points. The vertical line includes O with multiplicity one by step 1.4, yielding V+(-V)+O. Up/down arrowheads indicate the same projective direction O, never an extra affine vertex. At y=0 the caption correctly changes the finite multiplicity to two. Z=0 is explicitly not plotted and its divisor 3O is stated separately.
